recette.accroche: How well do you know your partner?
recette.consigne: 8 questions, 5 seconds each. Count your right answers!
questions: Is your partner a morning person or a night owl?
How many alarms do they set?
What do they do first when they wake up?
What time do they usually go to bed?
How do they take their coffee or tea?

fin.question: How many did you get? Comment your score!
